model: Maverick I Packaged Rooftop Unit Controller (MPS)
applies_to: Daikin Applied Maverick I (MPS) packaged rooftop units with the RTU-C unit controller and a BACnet communication module.
summary: The Maverick I rooftop unit controller talks BACnet IP, BACnet Ethernet or BACnet MS/TP through a plug-in BACnet communication module (a separate module covers LonWorks). The object list is short: unit state and capacities, application mode, emergency shutdown, occupancy, space, outdoor, discharge and return temperatures, setpoints, economizer and CO2 ventilation, dehumidification, VAV pressure and supply temperature points, two field inputs and alarm handling.
notes: Names are the point names from the main BACnet table (Table 7). The controller's own object names are short codes shown in the parameter detail pages (for example ApplicCmd, OccManCmd, EmergOverride, DischAirTemp).
Table 7 lists AV 63 and AV 64 together as Configurable Input 2 Type; the detail pages show them as the field input 2 low and high voltage range, so they are named that way here.
Three Device-object properties in the table (communication module version, application version, Location) are not separate objects and are left out.
BACnet Unit Support (MV 16) switches all values between English and metric; the doc gives metric as the default.
VAV points AI 14 and AV 67-69 were added in 2022 (BACnet software 2.06, unit controller 2.36 or later); field inputs and indoor fan mode need controller 1.5 or later.
The detail pages print some instance numbers inconsistently; instances here follow Table 7.

integration.summary: Set the keypad occupancy override setting to Network, then schedule the unit with Occupancy Schedule (MV 8) or force it with Occupancy Mode (MV 7). Write Application Mode and the occupied setpoints, and use Emergency Override to stop the unit. Read Unit State, capacities, temperatures and Current Alarm.

minimum_points.name: Effective Space Temperature
minimum_points.why: Space temperature in use (local or network)

integration.enable: Network occupancy scheduling needs the keypad occupancy override setting (OCCPCY OVERR SP) set to Network; then Occupancy Schedule (MV 8) or Occupancy Mode (MV 7) drives the unit. Emergency Override (MV 10) = Shutdown stops the unit and it will not restart by schedule or any other means until Normal is written.
integration.heartbeat: Receive Heartbeat (AV 43, seconds, default 0 = off). When set, the network inputs for occupancy schedule, application mode, remote supply fan capacity, remote space temperature, economizer enable and remote space IAQ must be rewritten within that time; otherwise occupancy reverts to Powerup, application mode and economizer enable to Auto, and the remote values to invalid.
integration.remote_sensors: Remote Space Temperature (AV 28), Remote Outdoor Air Temperature (AV 29) and Remote Space IAQ (AV 31) take values from the BMS; the effective values (AI 3, AI 4) fall back to the local sensor if the network value is unreliable. Remote Space Temperature Spt Adjust (AV 56) is used only when Room Sensor Setpoint Enable (BV 65) is set to Disabled (Network).
setup: BACnet IP defaults: IP 172.16.5.8, mask 255.255.0.0, UDP 47808, gateway 0.0.0.0; write 0.0.0.0 as the IP to turn on DHCP.
BACnet MS/TP defaults: MAC 0, 19200 baud (9600-76800 selectable); cycle power after changing the MAC.
Default device instance is 47065 for IP and 3002 plus the MAC for MS/TP; the device name is RTU_C followed by the instance.
Addressing is set with the BACnet communication module's web configuration tool (IM 1000); the module reset button restores factory defaults.
The communication type must be set to match the network (default BACnet IP).
gotchas: Writes to configuration points are stored in EEPROM/flash with a limited write life; don't write setpoints and configuration cyclically.
Clear All Alarms (BV 66) and Clear One Alarm (AV 57) only clear clearable alarms; some faults (smoke, emergency stop, sensor failure) can't be cleared from the network.
Values switch between English and metric with BACnet Unit Support (MV 16); check it before scaling temperatures.
Alarm numbers 1-99 are warnings, 100-199 problems, 200-254 shutdown faults.
